serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Hobo.Face.angry(instant)
Hobo: Shhh! Shut up!
You: W-why are you whispering?
Hobo: I told you to shut up! Ok?!
You: Wha-
Hobo: Zip it!
You: …
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: Look, we don’t know who might be listening. They can be everywhere!
Hobo: Were you followed?
You: No, I don’t think so. {{wi}}Why are we whispering?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: BECAUSE OF YOU!
Hobo: I mean, BECAUSE OF YOU!
You: Screaming in your whisper voice doesn't make it more silent.
Hobo: Whatever! 
Hobo: More importantly, what are you playing at, huh? Is this some kind of setup?!
You: What do you mean?
Hobo: Don’t play dumb with me. You said you were looking for clues to find your girl, but you didn’t say anything about someone getting freaking murdered here!
Hobo: Was that her getting done?! Did you do it to her?!
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: Of course not!
Hobo: So it’s not her.
You: N-no, I said no to the other question.
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Goddammit! What is wrong with you, huh? Why did you get me involved in this?! 
You: I-I’m sorry, ok? I didn’t think that you would actually find anything.
Hobo: Does the police know about this?
You: No…
Hobo: Why?! If you didn’t do it, why didn’t you call them? Murder is free to report!
You: It wasn’t that simple, alright?! Someone saw me, I had to stay low for a while!
Hobo: Someone saw you?! W-what if they followed you here!
You: Oh stop it! I already told you no one followed me!
Hobo: Don’t you get it?! They killed a nun in a church! A church! Whoever did it is a real psycho!
You: Jesus! Calm down, ok? Someone might hear us outside… What happened to whispering, huh?
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: I WILL calm down, but it doesn’t mean I’m not mad at you!
Hobo: Care to explain to me what this mess is all about?
You: One day the Priestbot stopped working. That nun I mentioned earlier tried to fix him, but…{{wi}} for some reason she couldn’t…
I can’t really say that it all happened because of m-{{wi}} I mean…{{wi}} Even if I decided to help her, it would probably end the same way…
I will just omit this part, I don’t want to provoke this hobo even more.
Hobo: I heard that all of these bots went out of commission, they were all rounded up and sent somewhere overseas.
You: And how do you know that?
Hobo: That’s just what I heard on the street, could be 100% made up by someone with a big mouth.
Then why are you saying it in the first place…
You: Anyway.
You: I came back here at night, but she was already, you know…
You: Then some guy came out of nowhere. He started screaming at me, telling me to piss off.
#Hobo.Face.scared
You: It was somewhere around that time that I noticed blood and bleach on the floor…
You: I wanted to run, but that guy grabbed my arm, didn’t want to let go. I finally got him off me and went straight home…
Hobo: D-dude, that’s fucked up…
Hobo: What are you gonna do now? 
You: I don’t know. For now, just tell me what you found.
Hobo: Y-yeah. In the cellar, there is a big bloody patch on the ceiling. Some of the… {{wi}}stuff…{{wi}} had to leak through the... 
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: There’s a cellar here?
Hobo: Yeah, I found it some time ago. No one has been there since the middle ages I think.
You: This church was built in 1895…
Hobo: It was just a figure of speech, ok?
Hobo: What I meant to say is that it was all dusty in there and the entry was covered up by some furniture.
You: How did you even find it then?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: I was…{{wi}} I was looking through stuff to sell, alright?! 
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: I’m not proud of it, but I need money to survive here.
You: Huh? You didn’t even try to bullshit me?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Well, for obvious reasons I’m not in a mood for bullshitting!
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: Should we go to the police?
Hobo: We? There’s no we brother, you are on your own! Haven't I done enough already?
Hobo: Besides, if you go to the cops, this whole place will go on lockdown. I will lose my new home!
You: You wanna sleep here? Knowing that someone was killed a few meters away?
Hobo: It’s better than freezing outside! I could sleep here like a baby, no problem.
Hobo: Listen, you will do whatever you want, I can’t stop you.
Hobo: Just tell me before you do it. I don’t want to be ambushed by a bunch of cops. If they try to pin this one on me, it’s like 50 years in solitary confinement! 
Hobo: But I will say this, maybe it will convince you. Even if you tell cops about this place and show them the evidence, there’s no way they will find the one who did it, even with today’s forensics. Did you at least see his face?
You: No, it was dark…
Hobo: See? It’s very unlikely that they will ever find him let alone prosecute him.
You: You know a lot about this stuff…
Hobo: I have some experience in these matters.
You: Were you a cop or something?
#Hobo.Face.smile
Hobo: Y-yeah something like that, s-sure.
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: Going back to the previous topic. I already decided to investigate as much as I could. I think I owe her this much.
Hobo: Oh man… {{wi}}Cops will close down this place and I will yet again end up on the streets. This sucks.
You: Sorry about that. I know you even helped me and all, but I believe that’s the right thing to do.
Hobo: If you say so. 
Hobo: Anyway, I’m gonna buzz off now. 
Hobo: Oh right, a few more things. As far as the police is concerned, I was never here, got it?
Hobo: I want to stay under their radar as much as I can. You owe me this much.
You: Alright, alright. My mouth will stay shut about it. Anything else?
Hobo: It seems like whoever murdered that girl knew what he was doing. Be careful, he may not have worked alone.
You: Roger that.
Hobo: Good. {{wi}}See ya later then and good luck.
You: Thanks, you too.
